weeks.content:
Set my little goal for the term
Kind, honest, hardworking

Do to others what I love
Practise in pairs

Stand and sing with respect
Flag etiquette

Story of the truthful child
Truth builds trust

Ask before taking
Return borrowed things

Clean body, clean room
Cleaning is a good habit

Obey mummy, daddy and teacher
Obey the first time

Let go and be free
Make peace quickly

Thank God for family, food and school
Count my blessings

Recite our rules
Character star ceremony
